languagetool.note: public API, bounded 300-pair subsample, rate-limit aware

verdict: kotoshu is competitive with the field on non-word correction: top-1 83.4% vs Hunspell 78.5% (kotoshu wins) and SymSpell 85.4% (SymSpell edges by 2.0pp, but returns a single candidate - top-3 is 92.8% vs 85.4%). The real-word class is hard for every context-free engine (9.1% best) - exactly the class the context-scorer arc targets, and this benchmark quantifies its value. LanguageTool's 0 is a benchmark-shape artifact: it checks full sentences, not isolated words, so its word-level score is not comparable to its real product contract.
